# rappter.com

> The consumer entry point for Genesis 251 First Edition / First Dimension:
> 251 signed First Edition Originals and authored shadow previews. All are
> issuer-held, untransferred, and undiscovered. Cleared Holo reveals, exact
> Original title transfers, separately issued offspring, RapterWorks jobs,
> tips, paid evolution, DOGG certification, and markets follow separate gates.

- First Dimension: https://rappter.com/
- Holodex viewer and API: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/
- Release stamp: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/api/v1/release/latest.json
- Species index: https://kody-w.github.io/holodex/api/v1/species/index.json
- RapterBox for business: https://rapterbox.com/
- Existing bounded work board: https://rappter.com/mesh/
- Public agent contract: https://rappter.com/agent.json

All 251 catalog slots are initially controlled by RapterBox, all 251 Original
titles are issuer-held, zero are transferred, and all remain undiscovered;
candidate source-content rights remain clearance-pending. A buyer may later
acquire current title to one exact cleared Original or a separately issued
offspring under stated terms. Neither is company equity or a security.
